question: An inductor of inductance $2\text{ H}$ carries a current of $3\text{ A}$. Calculate the magnetic energy stored in it. If the current is doubled, how many times does the stored energy become?

options.A:
$9\text{ J}$
On doubling the current, the energy becomes twice.
options.B:
$9\text{ J}$
On doubling the current, the energy becomes four times.
options.C:
$18\text{ J}$
On doubling the current, the energy becomes four times.
options.D:
$6\text{ J}$
On doubling the current, the energy becomes eight times.
